headline: Congress takes a legislative breather as both chambers meet briefly in pro forma sessions before resuming next week!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Thursday morning for just 26 seconds, conducting no legislative business. The chamber will remain in recess until Monday.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly Thursday morning, introducing 30 public bills and 5 resolutions before adjourning after just over an hour. No votes or quorum calls occurred, with the chamber primarily handling administrative matters.
